body:
New EMILY/docs/ECOSYSTEM_CONTINUITY_REPORT.md, organized and synthesized directly from CLAUDE.md's own authoritative per-repo table as of 2026-09-04: ~50 real repos grouped into the operational spine (EMILY/IDUNA/emily.cli/PRRJECT_FATBABY/APPLES/EmilyOS/PITVIPER), games & interactive worlds (GoblinFoxDragon/REDGARDEN/ECOWAR/SHANKPIT/BRAWLPIT/PAPERCRAFT/WEAKNIGHT_BEDROCK_RACERS/GTA7/EINHORN_SURVIVAL/skateboard/TYLER+MoneyPrinterTurbo/MISHRI), the PARENA language ecosystem (PARENA/BURROW/JEWEL/SAND/DUNG/LO/SPIDERBEETLE/MIXFORGE), the business/product layer (IDUNA_PRO/EMILY_FOR_BUSINESS/WOTAN/CONSOLE), infra/dev tooling, and new/stub repos. Closes with 4 real, synthesized cross-cutting themes: mods-first now a working discipline not just a goal, BURROW's Go target proven by its first real host adoption this session, a real ecosystem-wide kanban/backlog performance fix, and forking as this ecosystem's default growth pattern with a real, named recurring drift cost (GFD Battlegrounds). Registered as golden doc EMILY-ECOSYSTEM-CR; CLAUDE.md linked to it. MONOREPO commit 0f02ce2.

⚓ ☃
title: EMILY-CR-12414: full ecosystem continuity report shipped
